q_data.coordinates: limit t -> infinity (eps -> 0): q = beta - 1, legal iff beta > 2 i.e. q > 1; every candidate has exactly ONE stable interval (open cell of beta between consecutive critical roots)
q_data.what_an_endpoint_of_kind_root_certifies: the end-point is an isolated real root (Sturm count 1 on the stored interval, re-verified here) of the irreducible integer polynomial stored as minpoly (irreducibility re-verified here for all distinct polynomials); the 'vanishing' field names the critical polynomial(s) that vanish there (Delta = the Hurwitz determinant of the characteristic polynomial of -I+W, a_k = coefficient k of that characteristic polynomial, D = det K (positivity), o_k = off-support drive). The record certifies stability on the OPEN cell by an exact sample (constant verdict on a cell with no critical root inside, replay-checked isolation); AT the end-point a Hurwitz minor vanishes, which is three-valued undecided, so the end-point itself is never certified stable.
q_data.smallest_upper_end_discrepancy_note: the first campaign's synthesis line (notes/verify_n8/SYNTHESIS.json: 'smallest ~1.000276', copied into certificates/n8_limit_summary.json machine_confirmation.findings.q_upper_end_min_approx) disagrees with that campaign's own per-graph file notes/verify_n8/v_structure/q_upper_ends_refined.json, whose smallest entry is &GMBQMHtMH~]W in [77079731/77070336, 1079116235/1078984704] (about 1.000122); the exact refinement here agrees with the per-graph file. q_star_limit.attained_note: NOT attained in the limit map: the stable set of each candidate is the open cell below this root (the record's sample point and replay-checked isolation certify the open cell only); at q = q_8* the Hurwitz determinant Delta of the attaining graphs vanishes (three-valued undecided, not stable), and every other candidate's upper end is certified strictly smaller, so no candidate is certified stable at or above q_8*.
